regime_context: The TSX detector shows a broad, non-directional rotation: Oil & Gas Producers lead on rank (score 1.223) but with a middling durability bar of 0.56 and mixed Hurst, while Consumer Staples & Retail and Big Banks are both eligible, high-durability trends with the former now crowded. The one validated edge — the absolute-trend gate — is active and historically helps this market, so eligible trend themes are the only ones worth leaning on; the rest of the 16-theme universe is ineligible or unscorable, and cross-sectional rank is a focus lens, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Utilities & Renewables (XUT.TO, rank 5, durability 0.74, trend, eligible) can overtake Pipelines & Midstream (rank 4) and close the gap to the top three — a sustained move in XUT relative to XEG.TO would retire this watch and mark a confirmed defensive handoff.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: XST.TO is eligible, has the highest durability bar in the entire universe (0.83), a pure 'trend' Hurst tag, and perfect breadth (1.0). This is the strongest single candidate for the trend-gate's drawdown-control benefit even though it ranks second on raw momentum. The crowding flag (z=1.01) is a size-down caution only — it does not argue against the trend itself.
evidence: crowded: true (sizing caution, not a fade)
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.01 means the trade is consensus and the marginal buyer is thin; staples also carry rate-sensitivity/valuations at odds with a still-elevated macro inflation narrative.

falsifier.text: XST.TO drops below its 50-day moving average and stays there for 5 consecutive trading days

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: ZEB.TO is eligible, durable (0.82), a clean 'trend' Hurst tag, and full breadth (1.0) without the crowding flag that sits on Consumer Staples — effectively a less-crowded expression of the same eligible-trend discipline. It trails staples on rank but offers cleaner positioning for the trend gate.
theses.dissent: Banks are cyclical credit beta; if the macro environment turns to lagged rate-cut damage or credit stress, the trend can break hard despite current breadth.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags XST.TO by more than 4% over any trailing 10-trading-day window

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO leads the rotation (rank 1, score 1.223) and is eligible, but its durability (0.56) and mixed Hurst make it a weaker trend candidate than staples or banks. The lean is supported only by rotation leadership, which has no validated forward edge — so conviction stays low and the horizon is short. Crowding is absent, so no size-down flag.
theses.dissent: Momentum rank is not a return forecast; with r10 negative (-0.094) and mixed trend health, oil could easily hand leadership back without a durable trend to support it.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO gives back its entire rank-1 lead over ZEB.TO within 10 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
